---
name: dot-tool-notes
description: Creates a new, empty, correctly numbered note file in .dot/Notes/ using bash dot notes:create, optionally named (without a name it gets a random adjective-noun one, nNNN--swift-otter.md). Use it whenever an observation from the user or an agent should be parked for later rather than acted on — "note that down", "park this", "jot this for later", "leave a note about X" — then write the note into the file it prints. Reach for it rather than creating the file by hand, which gets the next number or the naming wrong.
metadata:
  internal: true
---

## Usage
```sh
bash dot notes:create --help
```
